name: UploadFile
description: Uploads a file or item to Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and upload files via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: DrivePath
fields.label: Drive Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint folder URL where the file will be uploaded (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/Folder).

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: The name of the file to create or replace in the target folder.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: The MIME type of the file (e.g., text/plain, application/json) or 'Base64' if content is base64-encoded.

fields.name: ContentBytes
fields.label: Content Bytes
fields.description: The file content as UTF-8 text or Base64 string depending on ContentType.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns metadata of the uploaded file, including ID, URL, and properties.
